title: tenant settings page in the browser

clauses.text: the tenant settings page shows items with their state badges, the write-only secret boxes and the save gate, and reads well on a browser

steps.do: As a tenant administrator, open the tenant settings page and read the items with their state badges.
steps.expect: Each item shows its state (ready, secret missing, vault locked, disabled or invalid) and its source file or api.

steps.do: Open the page on a phone-sized window or a phone.
steps.expect: The page reads at phone width with no horizontal scroll. Report anything that does not.
